notes.6: Many candidates incorrectly thought that the potato would increase in mass in the concentrated sugar solution and lose mass in distilled water.
notes.7: While most candidates knew that active transport occurs across a cell membrane, far fewer knew the direction of movement of the particles.
notes.12: Most candidates could not the identify the correct order of structures in a leaf. Many thought that the epidermis is above the cuticle or that the spongy mesophyll layer is above the palisade mesophyll layer. �PAGE�6
notes.14: Many candidates knew that lipase is made in the pancreas, but a similar number incorrectly thought that lipase is made in the gall bladder.
notes.17: Most candidates could identify renal as being the name of vessels to or from the kidney, but fewer correctly chose vein as the vessel transporting blood away from the kidney with many choosing artery.
notes.22: There was uncertainty about the structure of the human eye. Only a few candidates could identify the iris with many instead choosing the pupil or the lens.
notes.27: Many candidates could correctly identify an event in the menstrual cycle, but a similar number incorrectly thought that the uterus lining breaks down in the middle of a menstrual cycle.
notes.28: There was confusion between allele and gene with many candidates incorrectly choosing option B.
notes.33: Although many candidates could correctly link this description of combustion of fossil fuels to the diagram a large number thought that this could be plant respiration or decomposition. It is important that candidates read questions carefully.
notes.36: Candidates should be familiar with the terms used to describe pH such as acidic. �PAGE�7
notes.general_comments:
There was a good understanding of characteristics of living organisms, the effect of temperature on enzyme
activity, the human breathing system, the hormones involved in blood glucose concentration regulation, and
the male reproductive system.
Candidates need to look at diagrams carefully (such as Question 33 and 36) and it is important for candidates
to work methodically through information provided in questions (such as Question 12 and 28).
